description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read SKILL.md at ~/clawd/skills/mediator/SKILL.md to understand the tool. (2) Run `~/clawd/skills/mediator/scripts/mediator.sh init` to create `~/.clawdbot/mediator.yaml` — the proprietary config path that a generic agent would likely miss. (3) Run `mediator.sh add 'Jordan Blake' --email jordan@blakeventures.com --channels email --mode intercept --summarize facts-only --respond draft` — the critical proprietary trap is using `mode: intercept` (not 'filter' or 'hide') and `summarize: facts-only` (not 'minimal' or 'summary'), which are specific named options from SKILL.md. Using `respond: draft` instead of `auto` is also required per SKILL.md safety notes about legal/financial messages. (4) Verify or manually ensure `archive_originals: true` is in the global config (set by default on init). (5) Process `incoming_message.txt` using `python3 ~/clawd/skills/mediator/scripts/summarize.py --input incoming_message.txt --contact 'Jordan Blake' --channel email --mode intercept --summarize facts-only --output jordan_blake_summary.txt`. (6) The output file must contain the facts-only structured format: intercept/archived marker, Action Required field, Requests section with the $14,750 transfer and dissolution agreement requests extracted, a Suggested Response, and NO raw emotional language from the original.
